label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Hiriente de varón, y muere, de morir morirá.
spanish: Hiriente de varón, y muere, de morir será muerto.
grammarChanges: Changed 'morirá' (qal-style intransitive future, 'he will die') to 'será muerto' (passive future) to match the cited hophal imperfect 3ms stem force ('he is put to death'); 'de morir' (infinitive absolute) left unchanged.
